concept: Auto Scaling: self-healing via health checks and desired capacity
tests: Which configuration automatically replaces an EC2 instance that fails its health check.
expected: Auto Scaling group with health checks (EC2/ELB) terminates an unhealthy instance and launches a replacement on its own. Triggers: "failing its health check", "replacing it without human intervention", "self-healing".
why_not: A dashboard only visualizes; manual monitoring isn't automatic; termination protection gets in the way of replacement.
